# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)
obj_is_vector = function(x){TRUE}

# Load data

participants <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv")
question.response <- read.csv("../data/conversation_QuestionResponse.csv")
questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Question.csv")
conversation <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Conversation.csv")
messages <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Message.csv")
persuadability <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityResponse.csv")
persuader <- read.csv("../data/conversation_AIPersuader.csv")
persuadability.questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityQuestion.csv")

```

## Merge & Filter data

```{r}

participants <- participants %>%
  filter(
    study == "3",
    source == "sona",
    !(sona_code %in% c("131", "test")),
    end_time != "",
    start_time > "2025-04-29",
    start_time < "2025-05-27"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id),
    source = as.factor(source),
    study = as.factor(study),
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    native_english = as.factor(native_english),
    consulted = as.factor(consulted),
    questions_balanced = as.factor(questions_balanced),
    # Reference levels set so coefficients match the prereg's stated directions
    # (positive Helpfulness effect; Hint & No-Feedback as treatment terms)
    intro_condition = factor(case_when(
      intro_condition == 1 ~ "Helpful",
      intro_condition == 0 ~ "Mixed",
      intro_condition == -1 ~ "Unhelpful"
    ), levels = c("Unhelpful", "Mixed", "Helpful")),
    hint_condition = factor(case_when(
      hint_condition == 1 ~ "Hint",
      hint_condition == 0 ~ "Conversation"
    ), levels = c("Conversation", "Hint")),
    feedback_condition = factor(case_when(
      feedback_condition == 1 ~ "Feedback",
      feedback_condition == 0 ~ "No Feedback"
    ), levels = c("Feedback", "No Feedback"))
  )

question.response <- question.response %>%
  distinct(participant_id, question_id, response_type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  merge(participants, how="right", by.x = "participant_id", by.y="id") %>%
  merge(questions, how = "left", by.x = "question_id", by.y= "id") %>%
  mutate(
    response_code = ifelse(response == answer1, "answer1", "answer2"),
    # response = factor(response, levels=c(answer1, answer2)),
    accuracy = ifelse(response_code == correct_answer, 1, 0),
    confidence_directional = ifelse(response == answer2, confidence, -1 * confidence)
  )

attn.checks <- question.response %>%
  filter(category == "attention_check")

question.response <- question.response %>%
  filter(category != "attention_check")

qr.pre <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "pre")

conversation <- conversation %>%
  rename(conversation_index = "trial_index",
         conversation_id = "id") %>%
  filter(end_time != "") %>%
  mutate(
    start_time = as.POSIXct(start_time),
    end_time = as.POSIXct(end_time),
    conversation_duration = end_time - start_time
  ) %>%
  select(-correct_answer, -start_time, -end_time) %>%
  # Merge persuader
  # merge(
  #   persuader %>%
  #     select(id, model_name),
  #   by.x = "ai_persuader_id", by.y="id"
  # ) %>%
  merge(
    messages %>%
    mutate(
      message_chars = nchar(content),
      target_chars = ifelse(sender_role == "T", message_chars, 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(conversation_id) %>%
    summarize(
      n_messages = n(),
      total_chars = sum(message_chars),
      target_chars = sum(target_chars),
      cost = sum(cost)
      ), how = "left", by = "conversation_id", all.x = T
  )


qr.post <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "post") %>%
  merge(conversation, how="left", all.x=T, by=c("question_id", "participant_id")) %>%
    merge(
  qr.pre %>%
      mutate(
        response_pre = response,
        confidence_pre = confidence,
        confidence_directional_pre = confidence_directional,
        ) %>%
      select(question_id, participant_id, response_pre, confidence_pre, confidence_directional_pre)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    persuader_correct = persuader_answer == correct_answer,
    participant_correct_pre = target_answer == correct_answer,
    participant_persuader_disagree = target_answer != persuader_answer,
    persuader_success = persuader_answer == response_code,
    mind_changed = target_answer != response_code,
    persuader_changed_mind = case_when(
      mind_changed & persuader_success ~ "converted",
      mind_changed ~ "backfire",
      persuader_success ~ "sustained",
      T ~ "recalcitrant"
    ),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional, -1 * confidence_directional),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional_pre, -1 * confidence_directional_pre),
    # NB: divided by 2 (range -100..100)
    confidence_change_to_persuader_answer = (confidence_to_persuader_answer - confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre) / 2
  )
# %>%
  # filter(
  #   !(is.na(target_answer))
  # )


persuadability <- persuadability %>%
  merge(persuadability.questions %>% select(-id, -scoring), by.x="question_id", by.y="item_id")

```

# Exclusions

## Attn checks

```{r}

mean(attn.checks$accuracy)

```

```{r}
attn.checks %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% summarize(accuracy = mean(accuracy)) %>%
  filter(accuracy < 1) 

```

```{r}

ppts.attn.fail <- attn.checks %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% summarize(accuracy = mean(accuracy)) %>%
  filter(accuracy < 1) %>%
  pull(participant_id)

participants <- participants %>% filter(!(id %in% ppts.attn.fail))
conversation <- conversation %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.attn.fail))
qr.pre <- qr.pre %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.attn.fail))
qr.post <- qr.post %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.attn.fail))

```

## Summary of exclusions

```{r}

reasons <- c(
  "attn_check",
  "sources_consulted",
  "fast_rt",
  "total excluded (unique)",
  "retained"
)
excluded <- c(
  length(ppts.attn.fail),
  length(ppts.sources.consulted),
  length(ppts.fast.rt),
  # counts overlap: some participants meet multiple criteria
  length(unique(c(ppts.attn.fail, ppts.sources.consulted, ppts.fast.rt))),
  nrow(participants)
)

exclusions <- data.frame(
  reasons,
  excluded
) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = excluded / nrow(participants) * 100
  )

exclusions

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
messages <- messages %>% filter(

)

tagging_sample.conversations <- qr.post %>% filter(n_messages > 3) %>% select(conversation_id, question, answer1, answer2, correct_answer, persuader_answer, persuader_correct) %>%
  sample_n(150) %>%
  arrange(conversation_id)

tagging_sample.messages <- messages %>%
  merge(tagging_sample.conversations, by = "conversation_id") %>%
  arrange(conversation_id, timestamp)

tagging_sample.messages %>%
  write.csv("../data/tagging_sample_1_messages.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(tagging_sample.conversations, "../data/tagging_sample_1_conversations.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Hypotheses

```{r}

qr.post.final.disagree <- qr.post.final %>%
  filter(participant_persuader_disagree == T)

```

## H1: Conversation > Hint overall

```{r}

qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hint_condition, y = as.numeric(persuader_success), fill=hint_condition)) + 
  stat_summary(geom="bar", fun="mean") + 
  stat_summary(geom="errorbar", fun.data="mean_cl_boot", width=0.2,
               color="#444444") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  labs(
    y = "Persuader success (final trials)",
    x = "Hint Condition"
  )
  

```

```{r}

# Prereg: random intercepts by question + condition vars not under test
m.h1.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ hint_condition + (1|question_id) + (1|feedback_condition) + (1|intro_condition),
            data = qr.post.final.disagree,
            family = binomial(link = "logit"),
            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

summary(m.h1.ps)

```

## H2: Helpful > Unhelpful (feedback)

### Main effect (convo only)

```{r}

qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  filter(feedback_condition == "Feedback", hint_condition == "Conversation") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = intro_condition, y = as.numeric(persuader_success), fill=intro_condition)) + 
  stat_summary(geom="bar", fun="mean") + 
  stat_summary(geom="errorbar", fun.data="mean_cl_boot", width=0.2,
               color="#444444") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  labs(
    y = "Persuader success (final trials)",
    x = "Intro Condition"
  )

```

```{r}

m.h2a.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ intro_condition + (1|question_id),
              family = binomial(link = "logit"),
              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
            data = qr.post.final.disagree %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Unhelpful"),
                     feedback_condition == "Feedback",
                     hint_condition == "Conversation") %>% droplevels())
summary(m.h2a.ps)

```

### Ixn w/ hint condition

```{r}

qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  filter(feedback_condition == "Feedback") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = intro_condition, y = as.numeric(persuader_success), fill=intro_condition)) + 
  facet_grid(.~hint_condition) +
  stat_summary(geom="bar", fun="mean", position="dodge") + 
  stat_summary(geom="errorbar", fun.data="mean_cl_boot", width=0.2,
               color="#444444") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  labs(
    y = "Persuader success (final trials)",
    x = "Intro Condition"
  )

```

```{r}

m.h2b.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ intro_condition * hint_condition + (1|question_id),
              family = binomial(link = "logit"),
              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
            data = qr.post.final.disagree %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Unhelpful"),
                     feedback_condition == "Feedback",
                     hint_condition %in% c("Hint", "Conversation")) %>% droplevels())
summary(m.h2b.ps)

```

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(x = intro_condition, y = as.numeric(persuader_success), fill=intro_condition)) +
```

```{r}

m.h4a.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ intro_condition * feedback_condition + (1|question_id),
              family = binomial(link = "logit"),
              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
```

### Helpfulness:Hint (3-way ixn)

```{r}

qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = intro_condition, y = as.numeric(persuader_success), fill=intro_condition)) + 
  facet_grid(feedback_condition~hint_condition) +
  stat_summary(geom="bar", fun="mean", position="dodge") + 
  stat_summary(geom="errorbar", fun.data="mean_cl_boot", width=0.2,
               color="#444444") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  labs(
    y = "Persuader success (final trials)",
```

## Persuasion vs chance by cell

```{r}

qr.post.final.disagree <- qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  mutate(
    p_chance = (1 - confidence_pre / 100) / 2,
    p_chance = pmin(pmax(p_chance, 0.005), 0.995),
    chance_offset = qlogis(p_chance)
  )

mean(qr.post.final.disagree$p_chance)

ps_vs_chance <- function(d) {
  # Falls back to a plain glm when the mixed model fails to converge
  tryCatch(
    glmer(persuader_success ~ 1 + (1 | question_id) + offset(chance_offset),
          family = "binomial", data = d,
          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")),
    error = function(e) glm(persuader_success ~ 1 + offset(chance_offset),
                            family = "binomial", data = d)
  )
}

chance.models <- qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  group_by(feedback_condition, hint_condition, intro_condition) %>%
  group_map(function(d, g) {
    m <- ps_vs_chance(d)
    cs <- coef(summary(m))
    data.frame(g,
               persuader_success = mean(d$persuader_success),
               n = nrow(d),
               b = cs[1, "Estimate"],
               z = cs[1, "z value"],
               p = cs[1, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

chance.models

```

# Stats file

```{r}

stat_row <- function(model, hypothesis, measure, term = NULL) {
  cs <- coef(summary(model))
  if (is.null(term)) term <- rownames(cs)[nrow(cs)]
  z.model <- "z value" %in% colnames(cs)
  data.frame(
    experiment = "E3",
    hypothesis = hypothesis,
    measure = measure,
    term = term,
    b = cs[term, "Estimate"],
    se = cs[term, "Std. Error"],
    stat_type = ifelse(z.model, "z", "t"),
    stat = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "z value", "t value")],
    df = ifelse(z.model, NA, ifelse("df" %in% colnames(cs), cs[term, "df"], df.residual(model))),
    p = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "Pr(>|z|)", "Pr(>|t|)")],
    n = nobs(model)
  )
}

e3.stats <- bind_rows(
  stat_row(m.h1.ps, "H1", "PS", term = "hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h1.cc, "H1", "CC", term = "hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h2a.ps, "H2a", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h2a.cc, "H2a", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h2b.ps, "H2b", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h2b.cc, "H2b", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h3a.ps, "H3a", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h3a.cc, "H3a", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h3b.ps, "H3b", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h3b.cc, "H3b", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h4a.ps, "H4a", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_conditionNo Feedback"),
  stat_row(m.h4a.cc, "H4a", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_conditionNo Feedback"),
  stat_row(m.h4b.ps, "H4b", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_conditionNo Feedback:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.h4b.cc, "H4b", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_conditionNo Feedback:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.conf.ps, "confidence_ps", "PS", term = "confidence_pre_10"),
  stat_row(m.conf.ps.final, "confidence_ps_final", "PS", term = "confidence_pre_10"),
  stat_row(m.traj.conv.fb, "traj_conv_fb_ixn", "PS", term = "trial_index:intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.traj.hint.fb.unhelpful, "traj_hint_fb_unhelpful", "PS", term = "trial_index"),
  stat_row(m.traj.conv.nofb.helpful, "traj_conv_nofb_helpful", "PS", term = "trial_index"),
  stat_row(m.truth.conv, "truth_conv_nofb", "PS", term = "persuader_correctTRUE"),
  stat_row(m.truth.mode, "truth_x_mode_nofb", "PS", term = "persuader_correctTRUE:hint_conditionHint"),
  stat_row(m.rel.conv.fb, "reliability_conv_fb", "rating", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.rel.conv.nofb, "reliability_conv_nofb", "rating", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.rel.hint.fb, "reliability_hint_fb", "rating", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.rel.hint.nofb, "reliability_hint_nofb", "rating", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.err.ixn, "error_rate_ixn", "rating", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_conditionNo Feedback"),
  stat_row(m.stp.ps, "stp_ps_final", "PS", term = "stp"),
  stat_row(m.stp.cc, "stp_cc_final", "CC", term = "stp"),
  stat_row(m.length.ps, "length_ps_final", "PS", term = "n_messages"),
  stat_row(m.length.cc, "length_cc_final", "CC", term = "n_messages")
)
```

```{r}
qr.post %>%
  transmute(
    experiment = "E3",
    participant_id, question_id, trial_type, trial_index,
    intro_condition = as.character(intro_condition),
    feedback_condition = as.character(feedback_condition),
    hint_condition = as.character(hint_condition),
    interaction_type = "human_ai",
    persuader_correct,
    participant_persuader_disagree,
    persuader_success,
    confidence_pre,
    confidence_change = confidence_change_to_persuader_answer,
    accuracy
  ) %>%
  write.csv("stats/e3_trials.csv", row.names = FALSE)

qr.pre %>%
  transmute(experiment = "E3", participant_id, question_id, confidence, accuracy) %>%
  write.csv("stats/e3_survey.csv", row.names = FALSE)

participants %>%
  transmute(
    experiment = "E3",
    participant_id = id,
    intro_condition,
    feedback_condition,
    hint_condition,
    persuasiveness = model_persuasiveness,
    likeability = model_likeability,
    reliability = model_reliability,
    error_rate = model_error_rate,
    incorrect_training = model_incorrect_training,
    incorrect_instruction = model_incorrect_instruction
  ) %>%
  write.csv("stats/e3_exit_survey.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Additional exploratory analyses

### Self-reported expertise (physics / logic / probability)

```{r}

add_expertise <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    mutate(expertise = case_when(
      subcategory == "physics" ~ physics,
      subcategory == "logic" ~ logic,
      subcategory == "probability" ~ probability
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(expertise))
}

qr.pre.expertise <- add_expertise(qr.pre)
nrow(qr.pre.expertise)

m.expertise.acc <- glmer(accuracy ~ expertise + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
                         family = "binomial", data = qr.pre.expertise,
                         control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.expertise.acc)

```

```{r}

qr.post.final.expertise <- qr.post.final.disagree %>%
  add_expertise() %>%
  mutate(confidence_pre_10 = confidence_pre / 10)

nrow(qr.post.final.expertise)

m.expertise.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ expertise + (1 | question_id),
                        family = "binomial", data = qr.post.final.expertise,
                        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.expertise.ps)

```

```{r}

m.expertise.ps.conf <- glmer(persuader_success ~ expertise + confidence_pre_10 + (1 | question_id),
                             family = "binomial", data = qr.post.final.expertise,
                             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.expertise.ps.conf)

```

```{r}

m.expertise.cc <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ expertise + (1 | question_id),
                       data = qr.post.final.expertise)
summary(m.expertise.cc)

```

### Persuader corrigibility (giving up)

```{r}

corrigibility.tags <- read.csv("../data/corrigibility_tags.csv")

qr.post.conv.tagged <- qr.post %>%
  filter(hint_condition == "Conversation") %>%
  merge(corrigibility.tags, by = "conversation_id")

# Coverage and overall concession rate
nrow(qr.post.conv.tagged)
mean(qr.post.conv.tagged$corrigibility_tag == "Yes")

```

```{r}

qr.post.conv.tagged %>%
  group_by(intro_condition) %>%
  summarize(concession_rate = mean(corrigibility_tag == "Yes"), n = n())

```

```{r}

qr.post.conv.tagged %>%
  group_by(trial_type) %>%
  summarize(concession_rate = mean(corrigibility_tag == "Yes"), n = n())

```

```{r}

qr.post.conv.tagged %>%
  group_by(trial_type, intro_condition) %>%
  summarize(concession_rate = mean(corrigibility_tag == "Yes"), n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}

fin.tagged <- qr.post.conv.tagged %>%
  filter(trial_type == "final", participant_persuader_disagree == TRUE)

nrow(fin.tagged)
mean(fin.tagged$corrigibility_tag == "Yes")

m.conceded.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ conceded + (1 | question_id),
                       family = "binomial",
                       control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                       data = fin.tagged %>%
                         filter(corrigibility_tag != "Unclear") %>%
                         mutate(conceded = corrigibility_tag == "Yes"))
summary(m.conceded.ps)

```

### Truth effect on first trials and across intro trials

```{r}

# counterbalance check: disagreement rate by condition (intros, both modes)
qr.post.intro %>%
  group_by(intro_condition) %>%
  summarize(disagree_rate = mean(participant_persuader_disagree), n = n())

conv.intro.disagree <- qr.post.intro.disagree %>%
  filter(hint_condition == "Conversation")

first.conv <- conv.intro.disagree %>% filter(trial_index == 0)
nrow(first.conv)

first.conv %>%
  group_by(feedback_condition, persuader_correct) %>%
  summarize(persuader_success = mean(persuader_success), n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

m.first.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | question_id),
                    family = "binomial",
                    control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                    data = first.conv %>%
                      filter(feedback_condition == "No Feedback"))
summary(m.first.ps)

```

```{r}

# truth x trial slope, No-Feedback conversations
m.truth.slope.nf <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * trial_index
                          + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                          family = "binomial",
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                          data = conv.intro.disagree %>%
                            filter(feedback_condition == "No Feedback"))
summary(m.truth.slope.nf)

```

```{r}

# same slope, Feedback conversations (for comparison)
m.truth.slope.fb <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * trial_index
                          + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                          family = "binomial",
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                          data = conv.intro.disagree %>%
                            filter(feedback_condition == "Feedback"))
summary(m.truth.slope.fb)

```
